_approach: The triplet-adjacent pull written out on a 32nd grid rather than approximated with the linear `swing` field: kicks land at step 0, step 15 (not 16 - pulled a 32nd early) and step 26, so the second and third kicks sit off the straight 16th grid the way a true swung triplet would. Shaker and hats stay on plain 16ths (every other 32nd step) so the kick's displacement is audible against a straight reference. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
